scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 78 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

It crosses from Germany into Poland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
